This ground cannot be said to have reference merely to maintenance of order because it affects the locality and everybody who lives in the locality.

Under these circumstances we are unable to say that there has been a breach of section 7. In ground No. 3, again the whole locality was in danger as the detenu and his associates were armed with deadly weapons and these were in fact used for indiscriminately endangering human lives in the locality. The object of the detenu seems to have been to terrorise the locality and bring the whole machinery of law and order to a halt.
